title: GitHub: [Retroactive] Actions workflow run failures after deployment gate approvals
summary:
Oct 1 , 02:00 UTC
Resolved - On October 1, around 02:00 UTC, an isolated infrastructure failure caused GitHub Actions to lose execution state for a small number of existing workflow runs. Affected runs may remain stuck, fail deployment approvals, or return errors when cancelled. Service connectivity
